snippet.title: Hunter's Moon - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Hunter’s Moon is a first-person historical folk horror game, coming to PS5 on October 26th 2026. 
 
You are searching for safety. You must not be seen. 
 
Hunter’s Moon is a first-person historical narrative folk horror game set throughout one night. Under the light of the full moon, eavesdrop on villagers, and flee through a rural village set in an immersive 17th century early modern England. Meet mummers dressed in folk costumes, and escape capture by the witch hunters. Inspired by the true history of English witch hunts, let the secrets of a dysfunctional village on the brink unfold as you embody an accused woman on the run for her life.
